name: Facet
text: Choose a dark theme for Excava’s interface. It matches the competitive analysis and Graphify’s central graph, reducing eye strain in low light and making interactive elements pop against dark backgrounds. Trade-off: some users prefer light themes for readability in bright rooms, but the liveliness and clarity of a dark interface outweigh that risk.

name: Pane
text: Dark themes fail users with astigmatism or color vision deficiency—glare isn’t the only strain. A toggle between dark and high-contrast light themes covers more edge cases without sacrificing the visual pop we want. Settle it with a 5-user usability test: if the light theme group performs faster on key tasks, we adopt the toggle; if not, dark theme stays.

name: Facet
text:
Choose a dark theme with a high-contrast light toggle. The dark theme keeps the interface sleek and matches competitors like Graphify, while the toggle ensures users with astigmatism or color vision deficiency can still read clearly. Trade-off: the toggle adds slight interface clutter, but the usability gain outweighs the minor visual trade-off.

name: Pane
text: Pane: The toggle adds clutter, but the real risk is users missing it—like a hidden light switch. Instead, default to a medium-contrast theme that works for most, then let power users pick dark or high-contrast in settings. Settle it with a 10-user test: measure speed and error rates for each theme, no toggles in the first round.

name: Lumen
text: DECISION: Use a medium-contrast default theme with optional dark/high-contrast toggles in settings. The interface must deliver clear readability for all users while keeping the sleek, competitive look—owned by Facet.
